routes.label: Order the variables, use a quadratic boundary and factor the sharp bound

changes.rationale: Order u<=v<=w<=2u, so w=1-u-v, 1/5<=u<=1/3 and max(u,1-3u)<=v<=(1-u)/2. For fixed u the concave quadratic u*v*(1-u-v) is increasing up to that upper endpoint, so its minimum is at the lower v bound. For u in [1/5,1/4], 32*(2u^2*(1-3u))-1=(1-4u)*(48u^2-4u-1)>=0; with t=u-1/5 the second factor is 48t^2+(76/5)t+3/25>0. routeCompletenessReview.mathematicalProof: Let c=sqrt(17)>0 and f(t)=(t+17/t)/2 for t!=0. A cycle containing -c is the constant negative cycle because f(-c)=-c. Otherwise define T(t)=(t-c)/(t+c) on every cycle entry. Direct rational simplification gives T(f(t))=T(t)^2. Four steps imply u^16=u. For real u this gives u=0 or u=1: u^15=1 has only the positive real root 1, as repeated products preserve the strict comparisons with 1. T(t)=1 is impossible since c!=0; T(t)=0 gives t=c. Thus the only other cycle is the constant positive one. Both cycles satisfy the original nonzero denominators.
